string-array.item: Android TV: every page in the design, with the remote: the welcome, Settings, the video and music players, details and search.
The designer\'s cat lives on the idle screen, and Live TV\'s channel banner is an information bar like a cable box\'s.
The volume shows in a meter at the side of the screen (Settings > Volume indicator).
